rv.q: Filled with righteous anger as well as tongue-in-cheek anarchy, this likably chaotic show is a salient reminder that the culture wars didn't start in the 2020s.
Despite the chaos, the show wraps with a clear moral stance, a rousing call to arms, and heartfelt tribute to those who put their lives in peril for the greater good.
Act is a soul-crushing but ultimately uplifting musical that balances the light with the serious and moves just as much as it entertains.
